title: Static Broad Abdomen and Paired Sickle Jaw Antlion
description: One newly authored complete enlarged stylised antlion-inspired larva. A broad low rounded segmented abdomen narrows through a distinct neck into a flattened front head. Two long outward-then-inward anterior sickle jaws carry three integral blunt inner teeth each and surround a real open gap; they are not relocated posterior earwig forceps. Six short whole angular legs are grouped at the front half and end in true finite flat soles, with small lateral eyes and short antennae. Entire body sections, jaws and limb coordinates newly drawn; not old wingpad nymph stripped of wings. Four opaque matte PBR roles, no texture. One model zero scenes. Static exterior only; enlarged illustrative proportions, not exact anatomy or species identification, feeding, venom, microscopic hollow jaws, ecology, locomotion, rigging, animation or interaction.
